update.researcher_instruction: "c) ensure that the narrative does not violate the truth." (2026-10-14)
update.method: Every other chapter passage citing a Sheol/Hades/sleep verse was read against the corrected Ch 2. Ch 5: 'Sheol, the grave' (an equation no verse states) removed. Ch 9: Psa 16:10 and 30:3 were both called rescue of a living person, against Ch 2 and claim 3-9 (Peter reads 16:10 of Christ); restated. 10.12: working note said a Chapter 2 placement 'is on hold' (OT-08 closed 2026-10-09); restated with what is now in Ch 2 and what is not yet read (Job 18:14, Ecc 12:5, Acts 5; OT-02 item).
update.quote_note: the one non-match in Ch 9 is the saying it examines ('The soul goes to Sheol; the spirit goes to God'), not Scripture
